issues.location: satisfaction formula in the premise case
issues.finding: The satisfaction macro has both Gamma and A_n as successive formula arguments, leaving an extra argument instead of asserting satisfaction of A_n at w.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use mSat{M}{!A_n}[w] in the premise case.

issues.location: transition from the vacuous base case to strong induction
issues.finding: The source states that the claim therefore holds for all shorter derivations; this must be the induction hypothesis, not a consequence of the length-zero base case.
issues.proposed_resolution: Explicitly assume the claim for every derivation shorter than n when beginning the induction step.

translation_treatment: Translated the soundness induction with the assumption macro corrected and the induction hypothesis stated explicitly. Retained the editorial gap concerning a proof of axiom validity.
